question: Should this exact, more complete head be the canonical landing branch, or should the narrower maintainer-owned continuation at https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/2084 be advanced instead?
rationale: Both open PRs address the same defect and the related head is an ancestor of this one, but maintainer intent is needed to select one branch without duplicate merges or losing the additional hardening.

options.title: Land this exact head
options.body: Use this PR as canonical because it has exact-head live proof plus additional cancellation, persistence-coalescing, and regression coverage.

options.title: Advance the continuation
options.body: Move any required unique hardening into the maintainer-owned continuation, prove that resulting head, and close this PR only after the replacement is safely mergeable.
